remarks: Location, Location! Beautiful West Norwalk. This 3 Bedroom, 1 Bath Ranch home on 1.05 Acres Abutting Oak Hills golf course, is waiting for your Decorating Ideas to shine this gem into a diamond. Hardwood Floors throughout, Living room with a Fireplace, Eat In Kitchen, 3 Bedrooms and 1 full Bath. Full Unfinished Basement with many possibilities with plumbing already for your half bath to be completed. Could be finished for additional living space. Possible In-law or Playroom. High Ceilings and two full beautiful Pictures Windows over looking the Golf Course. Two ground level entrances. So many options! Detached two Car Garage. Great Yard with Stone Walls. Less than an hour to NYC and enjoy all Norwalk has to offer. SONO, Beaches, Shopping, Parks, Concerts, Maritime Aquarium, Restaurants and more.
